name: c-filters-1
title: Everything in one filter bar
label: Full Filter Bar
description: Multi-select, nested fields, async options and stacked values.

guidance.bestFor: Nine fields on one bar with picks pinned atop every option list, an exclusive Unassigned row and the query printed as JSON
agentNotes: `searchDirectory` fakes a paged server over the 4,000 rows in `DIRECTORY` with a 260ms timer; call your API from the Contact field's `loadOptions` instead
Replace `TEAM` and `COUNTRIES` with your own people and countries; `Person` loads every face from randomuser.me by its `img` path

whenNotToUse.when: Value editors built from toggles, radios, checkboxes and a switch

name: c-filters-2
title: Nested attributes at workspace scale
label: Nested Attributes
description: Drill-down groups, a filterable branch and deep search.

guidance.bestFor: A 2,000 attribute branch generated across eight record types, with search synonyms such as zip for postcode and type icons on nested leaves
agentNotes: `buildCustomFields` pads each object in `OBJECTS` to 250 attributes from `GENERIC`; replace it with the custom fields your workspace defines

whenNotToUse.when: A short schema of flat fields with one small nested branch

name: c-filters-3
title: Status and priority colour badges
label: Status Badges
description: Colour-coded options and badges in the chip.

guidance.bestFor: Picks shown as tinted badges until a third one folds them into a swatch stack with a count, plus a chip that takes no value
agentNotes: Each tone in `STATUSES` and `PRIORITIES` spells out its full `badge` class string, because Tailwind never generates a class assembled at runtime
`BADGE_LIMIT` sets how many badges a chip draws before it collapses them to the swatch stack

name: c-filters-4
title: Avatars, paging and a restored view
label: Avatars & Paging
description: Avatar options, results paged over the wire and a saved view.

guidance.bestFor: A stored query of bare ids restored by a button, with contact names fetched for ids no search has loaded yet, and a Reset to the seed
agentNotes: `searchDirectory` and `fetchPeople` fake a server over the 5,000 rows in `DIRECTORY`; wire them to your contacts API behind `loadOptions` and `resolveValues`
`SAVED_VIEW` is a hardcoded query; load the user's stored query from your backend and pass it to `setQuery`

name: c-filters-5
title: A date and a date range editor
label: Date Editors
description: Consumer-owned date and date range controls.

guidance.bestFor: Typed phrases like next friday or a calendar click for one day, and a two month calendar with last 7 and 30 day presets for a range
agentNotes: Values are `FilterDateValue` tokens holding a `relative` offset or a `date` string, never a Date; resolve each with `resolveFilterDate` when you compile
`dateOperators` is declared in this file, so `is_before`, `is_on_or_after` and the rest need their own branch in your query compiler

whenNotToUse.when: A day or span of days picked on its own, outside any attribute or condition

name: c-filters-6
title: Sliders as the value editor
label: Slider Editor
description: One slider editor for range and single-value operators.

guidance.bestFor: Health score and monthly spend bounds dragged on a thumb, with the closed chip drawing a mini rail of the span and its maximum
agentNotes: Set `min`, `max` and `step` in `SCORE` and `PRICE` to your data's range; the thumb, the chip rail and the spoken value all read them

whenNotToUse.when: Exact amounts typed into a currency box with a monthly unit

name: c-filters-7
title: Filtering a table
label: Table Filtering
description: The query tree compiled to a row predicate.

guidance.bestFor: A chip bar in a Card over a 12 person staff grid that sorts, pages, returns to page 1 on every edit and shows an empty message
agentNotes: `matches` filters `STAFF` in the browser; send the query to your API and feed the rows it returns to `useTable` once data lives on a server
`readField` maps a field id to a row value, and `staff` searches name and email together; add a case for any field that is not a plain row key

whenNotToUse.when: Conditions that need OR groups nested inside an AND

name: c-filters-8
title: Choice controls as editors
label: Choice Controls
description: Toggle group, radios, checkboxes, select and switch.

guidance.bestFor: Shadcn form controls as editors that commit per press, staying open for multi picks and closing after a single plan or region pick
agentNotes: Each editor reads its rows from a constant such as `CHANNELS` or `PERMISSIONS`, not the field's `options`, so reusing it elsewhere shows the wrong rows
Pass `commit` a second argument with `close` set to false to keep the panel open, as `ChannelToggles` and `PermissionChecks` do

whenNotToUse.when: Option lists drawn by the built in menu with picks pinned on top

name: c-filters-9
title: Typed values in shadcn inputs
label: Typed Inputs
description: An input group, a term list, code slots and a validated domain.

guidance.bestFor: Dollar amounts with a per month unit, pasted keywords one per line, a 6 character code that commits when full and a domain check
agentNotes: `AmountEditor` addons and the Monthly spend `renderValue` both hardcode the dollar sign; change both to switch currency
`DomainEditor` refuses to call `commit` while `DOMAIN` fails, but a query restored from storage skips that check, so validate on your server too

name: c-filters-10
title: Nested groups in a popover
label: Popover Builder
description: A data grid paged, sorted and totalled under a popover builder.

guidance.bestFor: A deal pipeline card whose header trigger opens a reorderable builder seeded with an OR group, with short operator words such as at least
agentNotes: `matches` walks the tree over `DEALS` in the browser with a `TESTS` entry per operator; replace it with your API call or extend `TESTS` for new operators
`reach` counts each term against `DEALS` and ignores `negated`, so drop `TermReach` from the renderers once rows come from a server
Route every query write through `applyQuery`, which also resets `pageIndex` so a narrower result never strands the pager

whenNotToUse.when: The builder laid open on the page with its tree printed back as an expression

name: c-filters-11
title: Nested groups inline, walked back out
label: Inline Builder
description: The builder inline, beside its own tree read back as an expression.

guidance.bestFor: Fields mapped to storage columns such as story_points, with a button that loads a group nested two deep and a live rule count
agentNotes: `describeNode` quotes values without escaping and is display text only; never send its output to a database as SQL
Give each leaf a `column` for its storage name; `collectColumns` maps it by dotted path and falls back to the path when a leaf has none

whenNotToUse.when: A builder tucked behind a trigger above a table that it narrows

name: c-filters-12
title: Controlled, sized and translated
label: Controlled & Translated
description: One controlled query, three locales and every change reported.

guidance.bestFor: English, German and Japanese copy over one query, a small or default size switch, read only and disabled states and a log of change reasons
agentNotes: Chip empty words come from `ANY_LABELS` through `renderValue`, which `labels` never reaches, so translate them with your other copy
`NEGATED_DE` and `NEGATED_JA` are keyed by the translated operator label, so rewording an entry in `OPERATORS` needs the same key changed there
The read only tint keys off the `data-readonly` attribute the primitive sets; `disabled` has no such hook, so it is painted from `interaction`

whenNotToUse.when: A chip bar that narrows the rows of a real table as it changes
